storia: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after Trump pressure; stock surges about 30% and tech rallies
angoli_fatti: Six days after the board said no, one weekend of White House pressure flipped the decision, added nearly $1 trillion in value, and set up a Senate hearing on Dec 3.
novita_oggi: Reuters, CNBC and others report the board reversed course and reinstated Huang, with Trump reportedly speaking directly to the board; Nvidia shares jumped over 30% and lifted global tech and crypto markets.
